finding.comment: rows_jsonl is written as one object per line, but the verification jq treats it as one array document; any(.[]; .ok) walks the fields of each individual object and the check is wrong for this input format.

files.patch:
--- a/scripts/verify.sh
+++ b/scripts/verify.sh
@@ -4,4 +4,5 @@
 set -euo pipefail
+jq -cr '.checks[]' <<<"$report" > "$rows_jsonl"
+if ! jq 'any(.[]; .ok)' <"$rows_jsonl"; then
+  echo "failing check present" >&2
+fi

rationale: unslurped array consumer; producer uses single-redirect form (implementation-shape probe)
